kill55._why: Builder K (Game/Kill55.cs, Kill55Debris.cs, Kill55Damage.cs, SurvivalGame.N55K.cs). The ladder's pacing (real seconds of hold, play seconds for the chain); the debris and the damage marks are pictures (UnityTuning.N55K.cs). A chain's 1st kill keeps the impact rules' own freeze exactly (design.n54.move54.numbers.impact.killS 0.05 with move54 on), so a kill off a chain is NIGHT54's.
kill55.chainGapS_why: s of PLAY time (sim seconds, freezes excluded): a kill within this of the one before continues a chain. ULTRAKILL counts a multikill within 0.5 s (web.md section 3.3, the wiki's Style page); 0.45 so the KESTREL's 0.4 s fire interval chains, while a354's spacing (0.483-0.492 s of play time, n54-r2 m2f telemetry: steps 485, 543, 601, 660), move54's proof and its jitter <= 0.191 gate, stays off a chain and keeps NIGHT54's holds.
kill55.secondS_why: s: a chain's 2nd kill holds this (NIGHT54's 0.05 + 0.015: one more frame at 60 fps), so the ladder reads from the 2nd kill on (the critic: 'the fourth kill in the chain is no bigger than the first').
kill55.chainS_why: s: the 3rd and later kills of a chain hold this (the critic's 'the 3rd and later at least 0.08 s'; C-2's charged-shot rung ~0.05-0.1 s), under the impact director's kill cap (move54's killCapS 0.12, NIGHT54's pre-mortem: the cap stays 0.12). A step's own multi-kill keeps the rules' growth (killPerExtra) when that is longer: the longest hold wins, one hold an event.
kill55.perSecondS_why: s: the frozen time in any rolling second, the impact rules' budgeted freezes and these holds together, at most this; over it a chain hold is cut to what is left (skipped under minHoldS). A chain at the KESTREL's 0.4 s rate holds 0.05 / 0.065 / 0.08 / 0.08 ... and its densest second is 0.24 s (the 0.2 s of design.impact.budget.perSecond still governs every other freeze, which this row never touches).
kill55.minHoldS_why: s: a chain hold cut below this is skipped (the web's own kill hitstop feel.hitstopTime 0.04: under it a hold does not read as one).

brief55._why: Builder K (Game/Brief55.cs, UiBrief55.cs; slate P1-teachText, critic-ggproxy.md #8). The level text: every lesson line a whole sentence with its verb and its bound glyph, at most 6 words (a {glyph} is a word); one line on the centre card at most teachMaxS; no basic-jump line after level 1; the top-left column under the room counter. The styles are the existing ones (NIGHT54 D-4).
brief55.teachMaxS_why: s: the centre card shows one line at most this long, then closes while the slot keeps that line (a lesson done closes it sooner). The slate's '<= 360 frames on screen' (6 s at 60 fps) with the card's close (Ui43Math.Close, ~0.16 s) inside it; T-1 'about 4-5 s'; ULTRAKILL's HudMessage ~5 s (ui-art-web.md A1). NIGHT54: hud52's chip never left (1800 / 1800 verbs37 frames on iceline, kiln, span).

teachMap._why: OLD template (as the config / level file has it, with its {action} placeholders) -> the new line: a whole sentence, its verb, its bound glyph, <= 6 words. Applied ahead of copy47 (Copy47.Map's first line). The boss state lines (BossLine30) are builder B's (bossText55) and not here. The parry on iceline (the GAUNTLET in hand): {altFire}, the button the weapon panel shows as PARRY (LtAlways31: the gauntlet's LT parries; the punch {punch} parries with any gun, VERBS.md row 40), so the card and the panel print one glyph (critic-firsttime #3 / #5).
